name: Stamp Me
oneLiner: Digital stamp card app for small businesses: customers collect stamps and redeem rewards on their phone, with no POS integration required.
bestFor: Independent cafes, coffee shops and small hospitality businesses that want a simple digital punch card.

updates.text: Stamp Me's blog (dated August 2026) describes Apple Wallet and Google Wallet support: members save a Member Code to their phone wallet, which staff scan with the Stamp Business merchant app (currently in a Merchant App beta).

features: Digital stamp cards customers join by QR code or the Stamp Me app
Several stamping methods, including the StampPod tap device, QR codes, stamp codes and Stamp Tags
Stamp Business merchant app: staff scan a member's code to stamp or redeem (beta)
Member Code in Apple Wallet or Google Wallet
Push notifications and SMS messaging to members
Automated birthday rewards and Scratch & Win games
Zapier connection to email and CRM tools

pricing.text: Three plans (Lite, Pro, Elite), each with a 30-day free trial, no setup fees and no cap on members. Prices are on Stamp Me's pricing page, which could not be opened; third-party sites disagree ($29 vs $49 starting), so no figure is given.

notes: stampme.com and help.stampme.com could not be fetched; facts come from search snippets of vendor pages. Dropped the original '$29/month' starting price (unverified; CostBench says $49). Launch date of Stamp Business and wallet support not confirmed; August 2026 is the blog post date. Case studies are vendor-published. Dropped 'six methods' count and Zapier detail on data fields.
